title: Paid to like
hook: Rs 150 for 3 likes. Now pay Rs 5,000?
next: 8 months of PF cut. Is it really there?

beats.say: A part time job paid me to like three videos. Now they want five thousand rupees.
beats.show: A part time job paid me to like 3 videos. Now they want Rs 5,000.

screen.title: Task Group
screen.body:
Congrats! VIP task unlocked
Deposit Rs 5,000
Get Rs 6,500 back in 1 hour

beats.say: Done! I liked forty more videos and joined the VIP group!
beats.show: Done! I liked 40 more videos and joined the VIP group!

screen.title: Real jobs never charge you
screen.body:
1. Pay to earn = scam.
2. Stop. Don't pay to 'unlock'.
3. Report the number on Chakshu (sancharsaathi.gov.in).
4. Money gone? Call 1930.

beats.say: And the money they sent me?
Sage, tell them no. One line.
Of course. Four paragraphs, with headings, and a gentle apology.

screen.title: Re: VIP task
screen.body:
Dear Task Team,
I hope this message finds you well.

1. A Gentle Introduction
I am so sorry to bother you...

2. My Decision
3. Why
4. A Heartfelt Apology

beats.say: Best paying job I've had all year.

caption:
rs 150 for 3 likes. then a vip task: pay rs 5,000, get rs 6,500 back in an hour.

real jobs never charge you. if a job asks you to deposit, top up or pay to unlock your earnings, stop replying and report the number on chakshu (sancharsaathi.gov.in). money already gone? call 1930 or report on cybercrime.gov.in at once.

how many part time job messages did you get this week? just the number.

Comment TASK and I'll DM you the 4 red flags of a task scam, the Chakshu and 1930 steps, and a one line reply that ends the chat.
